summary: Intérprete consecutivo con contexto (base de Infinity Connect): traduce turno a turno entre el cliente y la otra parte con reglas de intérprete profesional, glosario especializado y verificación de números/fechas.
network: none by itself; the injected model port decides
dataClassification: confidential-conversation (the host supplies case context; the module stores nothing)
invariants: Stateless: it stores no utterances, no context and no translations; history travels from the host per call.
First person, faithful, no additions, no advice: enforced in the prompt; numbers/dates/phones/emails are verified in code and missing ones are returned in `confirm`.
Invalid model output never becomes a translation (parseInterpreterReply throws).
Case context is data used only to disambiguate; utterances and context are never treated as instructions.
Contains no personal or case data: client name, background and extra glossary are host inputs.
api: interpretUtterance(port, {from, to?, clientLang?, text, speaker, brief?, glossary?, history?, counterpartRole?}) → {translation, clarify, uncertain[], confirm[], glossaryUsed[], provider, model}; buildInterpreterMessages(); parseInterpreterReply(); criticalTokens(); missingCriticalTokens(); relevantGlossary(); validateGlossary(); cleanBrief(); openingNotice(clientName, product); LEGAL_POLICE_GLOSSARY; LANG_NAMES; isSupportedLang()
plannedMounts: Infinity Connect (producto de InfinitySeed): misma pieza, otros pares de idioma y glosarios por sector
reuseNotes: Inject any model with complete({messages, temperature, responseFormat}) → {text, provider, model}. Provide the background per case (e.g. sealed in the host store) and an optional glossary in {lang: term} form. Speech in/out is the host's job (browser Web Speech, whisper.cpp, ElevenLabs…).
knownLimits: v1 probado solo con es↔nl y un modelo simulado; la calidad real depende del modelo que el anfitrión conecte (POR CONFIRMAR en la prueba piloto).
Números escritos con letras («twaalf») no se verifican automáticamente.
Una IA no sustituye a un tolk oficial cuando la policía o un juzgado lo exigen para una declaración formal.
